name: deletion_policy
desc: What happens on the device when objects managed by the resource are removed. `delete` deletes the object on destroy, including any configuration not managed by Terraform, and deletes single child objects once none of their attributes are configured anymore, unless the device holds other entries below them. `reset` deletes the objects created by the resource on destroy, resets the managed attribut…

name: device
desc: A device name from the provider configuration.

name: subinterfaces
desc: List of subinterfaces. - Map key: `interface_id` - Must match first field in the output of `show intf brief`. Example: `eth1/1.10`.

name: subinterfaces[*].bandwidth
desc: The encapsulated routed interface bandwidth. - Range: `0`-`3200000000`

name: subinterfaces[*].delay
desc: The encapsulation routed interface delay. - Range: `1`-`16777215`

name: subinterfaces[*].encap
desc: The routed interface encapsulation VLAN. Possible values are `unknown`, `vlan-XX` or `vxlan-XX`.

name: subinterfaces[*].mtu
desc: The encapsulation routed interface MTU. - Range: `576`-`9216`

name: subinterfaces[*].mtu_inherit
desc: The encapsulation routed interfac3 inherit MTU from global policy.

name: subinterfaces[*].router_mac
desc: The encapsulation routed interface MAC router.

name: subinterfaces[*].snmp_trap
desc: Administrative Port Snmp Trap State. - Choices: `enable`, `disable`
